vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: nm-tome-code-search
Version: 1.0.1

The skill bundle provides instructions for an AI agent to perform GitHub code searches. It contains only metadata and a workflow description (SKILL.md) referencing external functions for query building and result parsing, with no executable code, suspicious commands, or evidence of malicious intent.

llm.summary: This instruction-only skill appears benign: it describes searching GitHub for code examples and includes no code, install steps, credentials, or local data access.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose, GitHub code search, matches the workflow described in SKILL.md.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill directs use of WebSearch and optionally the GitHub API, which is purpose-aligned but means search queries may be sent to external services.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec for this skill, but SKILL.md references an external Claude Code plugin for a fuller experience; that external plugin is outside this review.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No required binaries, environment variables, credentials, config paths, or local file access are declared.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifacts show no persistence, background execution, privilege escalation, credential use, or mutation authority.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is reasonable to use for finding public GitHub examples. Do not include confidential code names, secrets, or private implementation details in searches, and review any separate Claude Code/Night Market plugin before installing it.

evidence.explanation: The skill explicitly relies on external search/API tools. This is aligned with the GitHub code-search purpose, but users should understand that search terms may be sent to third-party services.
evidence.snippet: Execute queries via WebSearch ... Optionally use GitHub API via `build_github_api_search()` for richer metadata

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Use this for public code searches and avoid putting secrets, private repository details, or confidential project information in search queries.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: Search queries could be visible to web or GitHub-related services used by the agent.

evidence.explanation: The reviewed skill is instruction-only, but it points users to an external plugin that is not included in the provided artifacts and was not reviewed here.
evidence.snippet: Night Market Skill — ported from [claude-night-market/tome]... For the full experience with agents, hooks, and commands, install the Claude Code plugin.

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Review the external plugin separately before installing it; this evaluation only covers the provided SKILL.md.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: Installing the separate external plugin may introduce additional code, hooks, commands, or permissions not covered by this review.

abnormal_behavior_control.summary: Only purpose-aligned external search/API use and an external plugin reference were noted.

permission_boundary.summary: No credential, account, or privilege-bound access is shown in the artifacts.

sensitive_data_protection.summary: No persistent memory, local private data indexing, inter-agent communication, or sensitive-data handling is shown.
